meta.meta_title: Multifunctional interfacial and structural anode for dendrite-free lithium metal
meta.meta_authors: SHEN Chao(沈超) 1 , LI Nan(李楠) 1 *, GU Jin-lei(顾金镭) 1 , PENG Zu-ling(彭祖铃) 2 , XIE Ke-yu(谢科予) 1 *

materials.name: E1-treated Li anode
materials.description: Li foil treated with 0.17 M AgNO3 in DOL solution, resulting in spherical Ag particle morphology.

materials.name: E2-treated Li anode
materials.description: Li foil treated with 0.17 M AgNO3 in DME solution, resulting in spherical Ag particle morphology.

materials.name: E3-treated Li anode
materials.description: Li foil treated with 0.17 M AgNO3 in DOL/DME (1:1) solution, resulting in mixed plate-like and spherical structures.

materials.name: E4-treated Li anode
materials.description: Li foil treated with 0.17 M AgNO3 in DOL solution with 1 M LiTFSI, resulting in 3D microrod structure.

materials.name: E5-treated Li anode
materials.description: Li foil treated with 0.17 M AgNO3 in DME solution with 1 M LiTFSI, resulting in 3D microrod structure.

materials.name: ME-Li anode
materials.description: Primary material: Li foil treated with 0.17 M AgNO3 in DOL/DME (1:1) with 1 M LiTFSI (ME solution), forming an in-situ 3D Ag/Li-Ag microrod layer enabling dendrite-free cycling.
